BLAZING ELECTRIC MAGENTA and VIVID SILVER panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic, bright light passing through each tiny pane with sharp refraction glints, NO airbrush NO gradient wash. Background: a bright grand railway station concourse with a pale stone floor, tall arched windows, standard-height doors and a long bench, professional octabox strobe, high-contrast glamour lighting, dark glamour mood, intense dramatic atmosphere, powerful editorial energy, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle.
